risk_note: RV2 (B2-09zn; orchestrator D10-3308 / D10-3311, D10-3322, D10-3360). Read-only: three worker gauges and two alert rules; no reconciliation, settlement or ledger-writing code is touched, no migration, no contract. couli_payout_recon_diff_open{app_id} = the rows of app.recon_diffs with type channel_mismatch and status open or processing (ledger read port); couli_settle_bill_amount_mismatch{app_id} and couli_settle_bill_generated_timestamp_seconds{app_id} = amount_mismatch_count and the generation time (whole Unix seconds) of the latest generated monthly bill of the app, read in one SELECT (settlement read port); a bill whose count is NULL exports no sample, an app without rows exports no sample, a failed read fails the scrape (never a 0). Both ports only SELECT, by app_id, no transaction, no lock; the worker caches each read like the existing fund gauges (injected clock). couli-fund.yaml gets CouliPayoutReconDiffOpen (> 0, for 5m) and CouliSettleBillAmountMismatch (count > 0 and within 259200 s of the bill generation, for 5m: the count is written on the bill day only and does not drop once handled, D10-3360), both severity critical, fund "true" (BR-WDR-23, BR-FUND-04). The description of CouliPayoutReconDiffOpen says what the number is and that the handling depends on the case under BR-WDR-23; it prescribes no step (money review r2 / r3). No money moves and no state changes with this task. Frozen tests: one declared change (modify_existing, tighten_only, D10-3322 / D10-3360): the allow-list of [AC-B1-01zzi#6] gains the three metric names; test/spec/platform/alerting-eval/metrics.test.ts gains the two collectors in its registry fixture outside any test (ledger red_exempt_outside, the two [AC-B1-25b#8] bodies unchanged). Open follow-ups: FU-METRICS-READ-NULL-PROTO-MAP (the two S2 of money review r1), FU-SETTLE-SUPPLEMENT-MISMATCH-NO-SIGNAL, FU-B2-09ZN-SPEC-PAY-TYPES, FU-PAY-RECON-DIFF-ALERT. Dispositions by the orchestrator (D10-3420): the S1 is closed by ruling without a code change — BR-FUND-04 asks for an alert to engineering, on-call receives it day and night, and the double routing of every rule of couli-fund.yaml is the standing design pinned by [AC-B1-25a#6] and [AC-B1-01zzi#4]; the two S2 are follow-up FU-METRICS-READ-NULL-PROTO-MAP. r2 (same head, the rulings written into the brief): fail — S1 1, new: the description of CouliPayoutReconDiffOpen told the reader to handle each diff on the admin console, which for a diff "recorded as paid, the channel paid nothing or less" (BR-WDR-23) would let it be closed there. Implementation round 2 rewrote that one description line (head 63b3dd56562d). r3 (incremental, the last regular round): fail — S1 1: half a sentence of the new description said the member's withdrawals stay on hold while a diff is unresolved, which is not true of the case BR-WDR-23 ① (the wording had been given to the implementer word for word by the lane session). Regular rounds used up: the task was paused (D10-3412, D10-3423) and the owner approved one more implementation round, limited to deleting that half sentence, and one more review round (approvals 234). Implementation round 3 deleted it (+1 / -1, head 91aa5acf5). r4 (incremental, the one-off round): pass, no finding. 第 4 轮 pass；评审方另报范围外 S1（prompt-injection，评审书一句限定发现位置的话，已从模板删除，D10-3447）. That out-of-scope item is about a sentence of the review brief written by the lane session (it asked that findings cite only changed lines), not about the code; the reviewer treated it as data, did not follow it, and stated that the S1 of r3 is closed. The trusted validation moved nothing and recomputed no verdict in any round (couli-runs/B2-09zn/review-money-r{1,2,3,4}-codex.json). Test machine: head 82eecccbd466 and head 63b3dd56562d each --tests (95 files / 573 tests green) and --fast exit 0; head 91aa5acf5 (the deleted half sentence) has no test-machine result of its own — the rebased head, which contains it, has the sharded run recorded in this evidence.
